units.rawText: What experiment is being conducted right now? Er... actually, we were planning to celebrate Halloween with a big demolition project, so we borrowed the Abax Gallery from Anna to test it out.

units.rawText: I've also hidden a few small prizes deep within the area to add to the spirit of things; let's see how many you can pick up while blasting your way out with explosives.
